candidates.statement: The stakeholder explains how he builds connections on LinkedIn (topic of the interview).

evidence_candidates.quote: today I'm going to talk about how how I build connection on Linkedin

candidates.statement: Enlarge the number of connections displayed on his LinkedIn profile.

evidence_candidates.quote: So the 1st one is to enlarge my the number of my connections on my profile

candidates.statement: Show people that he is active on LinkedIn.
candidates.modality: stated as the reason for increasing the number ('pretty important')

evidence_candidates.quote: to make sure that I to to show people that I'm active on Linkedin

candidates.statement: Get referrals from current employees for his 3rd company.

evidence_candidates.quote: my sec second goal is to to get referrals from current employees for my 3rd company

candidates.statement: A referral helps his resume be seen by recruiters, because internship and full-time applications are competitive.

evidence_candidates.quote: It's pretty competitive. And sometimes a referral really helps to get my resume being seen by recruiters

candidates.statement: Search LinkedIn with the company name and the name of the university he currently attends to obtain a list of people with the same background.
context: when he wants to connect with people to ask for a referral

evidence_candidates.quote: So when I want to connect with people for a referral. what I would 1st do is to to search on in the search bar. This company name, and also the school name that I am currently attending like

candidates.statement: Click into a candidate's profile, read their experience, and hit connect only if that experience is exactly what he is looking for.
context: only if their experience matches what he is looking for

evidence_candidates.quote: and then I am going to click on, click into their profile and to see about their experience. If their experience are the exactly what I'm looking for. Then I'm going to hit the connect button

candidates.statement: Add a message/note with the connection request that introduces himself and tells the person he would like them to refer him for the position.
context: note is sent with the request before the invitation is accepted

evidence_candidates.quote: and I will usually like add a message to introduce myself and I maybe will also tell them like I want to. If they will like to refer me for the position

candidates.statement: Wait for the invitation to be accepted, and if it is, chat with the person for further details; if not, the request stays pending.
candidates.modality: process possibility ('I can then'), not a stated want
context: only if the invitation is accepted

evidence_candidates.quote: And then after this, I will just like wait to see if they except my invitation to connect. and if they do, I can then start to chat with them for the further details

candidates.statement: Filter out former company employees (they cannot refer him) and people who satisfy only one or none of his requirements.

evidence_candidates.quote: They are not current employees, so they are not able to refer me for the position
They only satisfy, like one of the one, or like none of the that the requirements I want

candidates.statement: Choose only people who are currently a company employee and who was a student at his university.

evidence_candidates.quote: I will only choose people who is currently a company employee and who was my university's student

candidates.statement: Tell the person in the message that he was also a student at that university, in order to increase the possibility that they refer him.

evidence_candidates.quote: I can tell them that I was also like a student in my university, and to increase the possibility that they want to refer me for the position

candidates.statement: Students who attend the same university tend to want to help alumni, which raises their willingness to refer him.

evidence_candidates.quote: Students who attend the same university tends to like want to help the alumni

candidates.statement: Only a company employee is able to refer him for a position at that company.

evidence_candidates.quote: then only company employee is able to refer me

candidates.statement: LinkedIn search does not always return the people he wants; he goes through many profiles that do not fit his target connections.

evidence_candidates.quote: Linking doesn't like always provides me with the result I want

candidates.statement: LinkedIn Premium members can see as many search results as they want, while non-members only access a limited list; in the worst case only one or two or none of the results fit.

evidence_candidates.quote: you are a linking premium user, then you are able to check like as many as result of
in the worst case, like there are just like one or 2, or even none of the people in the search result

candidates.statement: Purchase LinkedIn Premium, as the simplest way to access as many potential connections as he wants, even though it costs a lot.
candidates.modality: preferred/usual option with cost caveat ('usually', 'simplest way', 'costs a lot')
context: preferred because it is the easiest way, but expensive

evidence_candidates.quote: is just to purchase the linking premium, because, like this, allow me to access like as much as possible potential connections as I want to
But this is pretty like this costs a lot

candidates.statement: Modify the search keywords (delete one or two of them, or make them more specific) so that LinkedIn returns people with a more precise background.
candidates.modality: alternative option ('sometimes I may turn to the other option')
context: used as the alternative when results are unsatisfactory

evidence_candidates.quote: to modify the keywords in my when I was doing the searching. so I may kind of like delete one or 2 of the keyword. or like to be more specific

candidates.statement: The note sent with a connection request is limited to 200 characters for non-members, which is too little to convey what he wants to say and takes time to compress.

evidence_candidates.quote: usually for a non-member is 200 characters
it really takes some time for me to like, shrink them words in my message

candidates.statement: Convey in the limited note what he wants to talk to the person about.
candidates.modality: difficulty framed wish ('really convey what I want to talk to them')

evidence_candidates.quote: only a limited like number of words to really convey what I want to talk to them
